note: Oceana County park on 100 acres on Black Lake in Colfax Township, near Walkerville; swimming, fishing, a boat launch and a playground. --Claude
summary: Oceana County park page: 14 sites, all electric (was 15 with 11 electric), $25/night, $175/week, $1,500 seasonal (5 months), one rate (no non-resident split), reserve by phone 231-923-1344, season closes Oct 31 (page still dated 2025; no opening date). Amperage, water/sewer and facilities not stated. Note's site/electric count dropped (contradicted).
flags: Phone: the county page gives 231-923-1344 for availability and reservations; the entry has 231-638-3365.

Seasonal sites: the park also lets sites by the season ($1,500 for 5 months); the county does not say how many of the 14 go to seasonals, so the nightly share is unknown. Nightly and weekly rates are posted and the page takes nightly reservations.
